counter_evidence.quote: This 2-day, comprehensive aesthetic medical training course takes the bedside clinician to the beautiful world of aesthetics, covering Neuromodulators, Dermal Fillers, Deoxycholic acid, and more!
The Aesthetic Institute (AI) is a training institution that provides instructional seminars in aesthetic medicine.

prior_reason_rebuttal: Prior reason ('Aesthetic-medicine training school for professionals — not a patient clinic') is confirmed rather than falsified. Every course page (Bedside to Beautified, Neurotoxin Presentation, Courses Page, Home) targets 'the bedside clinician'/'medical professionals'/'aspiring aesthetic injector' seeking CME-accredited injector certification, priced per-seat ($2500-$3499), with no patient booking or service menu. Per rule 6 the apex myaestheticinstitute.com was also probed: it is the SAME training entity (course catalog, 'Meet the Team' of Clinical Education Specialists, CME accreditation), not a separate patient clinic — it explicitly names a different sister company ('My Face Lady PLLC... concierge med spas') as the actual clinic, which is a distinct domain outside this scope. No page on either host lists a public/patient-bookable service.
proposed_markdown_reason: Training academy: courses.myaestheticinstitute.com (and its apex myaestheticinstitute.com) sell CME-accredited injector courses to medical professionals only; the actual med spa is a separate sister company/domain (My Face Lady), so there is no patient-facing clinic on this domain.
